final_response: Reply sent to `customer@client.com` acknowledging the blocked deployment and the lack of support response, and assuring them the matter is being actively looked into.

args.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the blocked deployment and for the delay in our support response.

We want to assure you that we are actively looking into both issues — the deployment blockage and the lack of a timely response from our support team. Resolving this is a priority for us, and we will keep you updated as we make progress.

If you have any additional details to share in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reply to this email.

Best regards,
Support Team
